resources.string: Turn this phone into an SMS gateway
Your apps send and receive SMS through this phone\'s SIM cards.
Send SMS, data SMS and MMS from your own code
Get replies and delivery reports at your webhooks
Use it on your local network, through Homing Cloud, or both
Homing asks for one permission at a time. Each one says why it\'s needed.
All set. Homing has what it needs.
Android won\'t ask again. Turn it on in the app settings.
Your apps send messages through this phone\'s SIM cards.
Replies reach your inbox and webhooks, including opt-outs like STOP.
You won\'t see replies, and opt-outs are missed.
Homing reads which SIM cards are in the phone, their carrier and signal.
You can\'t choose a SIM, set daily caps or see signal problems.
A small ongoing notification keeps Homing running in the background.
Android is more likely to stop Homing, and you won\'t get alerts.
Phones stop background apps to save battery. That is the most common reason messages stop sending.
Battery optimization is off for Homing
Also on Xiaomi, Redmi and POCO
Open Settings, then Apps, then Manage apps, then Homing.
Tap Battery saver and choose No restrictions.
Open Settings, then Battery, then Background usage limits.
Add Homing to Never sleeping apps.
Turn off Put unused apps to sleep, or make sure Homing isn\'t on that list.
Open Settings, then Battery, then App launch.
Find Homing and turn off Manage automatically.
Turn on Auto-launch, Secondary launch and Run in background.
Also on OPPO, realme and OnePlus
Open Settings, then Battery, then App battery management, then Homing.
Turn on Allow background activity and Allow auto launch.
Also on Tecno, Infinix and itel
Open Phone Master, then Auto-start management, and allow Homing.
Open Settings, then Battery, then App power saving, and set Homing to No restrictions.
Open recent apps, long-press Homing and tap the lock.
Open Settings, then Apps, then Homing, then Battery, and choose Unrestricted.
Leave the Homing notification on so Android knows it\'s working.
Android 13 and later block SMS access for apps installed outside an app store until you allow it once.
Tap the three-dot menu in the top corner.
Tap Allow restricted settings and confirm with your PIN or fingerprint.
You can change this later in Settings.
Apps on the same Wi-Fi call an API running on this phone. Nothing leaves your network.
Apps anywhere call the Homing Cloud API and this phone picks up the messages.
Run the local API and stay connected to Homing Cloud.
Scan the QR code shown in the console, or type the pairing code.
Homing sends an SMS to this number and shows it arriving.
Use this phone\'s own number to see it come back.
Check the SIM has credit and signal, then try again.
